notes.title: The End of Pinbot Development
notes.content:
Dear players,
[b]I have decided to discontinue the development of Pinbot. Version 1.2.3 will be the final release[/b], and the game will remain available in stores as long as no issues arise. Pinbot did not achieve the success I had hoped for. I’ve written an article explaining the reasons behind this decision. You can read it here: https://www.sante76.eu/pinbot-future/.


I sincerely thank everyone who played and supported the project. Your enthusiasm has been a great source of motivation for me.

notes.title: Important update: video codec, mouse, and leaderboard.
notes.content:
Summary of changes:
[list]
[*] Resolution of the video codec issue, which caused crashes.
[*] Resolution of the mouse issue introduced in version 1.2.0.
[*] Resolution of minor issues with the leaderboard.
[/list]

[b]Video Codec[/b]
We consider it important to try to avoid, as much as possible, annoying events such as application crashes. The videos included in Pinbot, including some completely unsuspected ones, were historically created in WebM format. This video format turned out to be problematic, to the extent of causing random and unpredictable crashes of the application. The VP8 codec caused so many headaches for the Godot team that it was decided to abandon it completely in later versions of the game engine.
The solution to the problem was to abandon the WebM format in favor of Theora, the only other format supported by Godot. Unfortunately, this involved rendering all the internal videos of the game and, consequently, a rather heavy update in terms of the amount of data to download.

[b]Mouse[/b]
It happens! With the upload of version 1.2.0, the use of the game controller was introduced, as requested by some users. Unfortunately, a bug was also introduced, whereby the "braking" system linked to the use of the game controller interacted erroneously with the mouse, which thus found itself subjected to two different "brakes" at the same time... For those who understand, a single stupidly badly nested "if"...

[b]Leaderboard[/b]
A small bug was discovered in the leaderboard, which made some records "disappear" into thin air, simply because they were poorly registered by the system.

notes.title: Critical bug encountered!
notes.content:
Thanks to the user HYBRiS, a critical bug introduced with version 1.2.0 has been discovered, which practically renders the game unplayable with the mouse, while it works with a game controller. Unfortunately, it happens!

[b]The solution is already prepared and is in the uploading phase.[/b]

I warmly thank HYBRiS for the report.

notes.title: Added game controller support. Solved some TDR problems.
notes.content:
The support for game controllers has been added, in response to a request from users. At the same time, efforts have been made to address the TDR issue related to the Microsoft Windows operating system, by working on textures, audio files for sound effects and the autotune algorithm.
The autotune has been disabled by default as it was found to be the cause of some otherwise inexplicable crashes.
More info at [url=https://www.sante76.eu/pinbot/]sante76.eu[/url] website.

notes.title: Pinbot is one of "Top 4 Best Indie Games – February 2024" by www.indiexpo.net!
Improvements regarding particles system
notes.content: To improve the performance of the game at the GPU level, all particle systems have been revised, some of which were still managed by CPUs due to historical causes, all with the aim of further improving the performance of the game.

notes.title: Stability improvement
notes.content: Some interventions aimed at increasing the stability of the game. Stress tests were carried out for 24 hours without finding any blocking and/or crash problems.

notes.title: Some threading problem solved
notes.content:
Fixed some issues related to the use of threading with Godot, trying to work around some known bugs related to unexpected crashes.
Made minor changes, such as introducing the warning for "loud sounds and strobe lights".
